Description: Are you looking to enhance your career opportunities as an educator, expand your mastery of mathematical content areas and network with your peers in the field? The University of Central Missouri's Elementary Mathematics Specialist graduate certificate offers all this and more — in an affordable program designed for working teachers. [8] The Elementary Mathematics Specialist graduate program, aligned with National Council of Teachers of Mathematics (NCTM) standards, is available to both residents and non-residents of Missouri, and offers three tracks leading to different credentials (a graduate certificate, an MSE and an EdS). [8] The graduate certificate can be completed in the least amount of time. [8] The course credits earned will prepare Missouri educators for the Missouri Department of Elementary and Secondary Education (DESE) Elementary Math Specialist content exam, necessary for obtaining the Missouri DESE add-on teaching certificate. [8] Coursework for your Elementary Mathematics Specialist graduate certificate will focus on math content, leadership and pedagogy. [8] In your content courses, you'll renew and enhance your confidence in elementary mathematics while looking at the content through the lens of curriculum design. [8] In professional development courses, you'll study leadership theories and principles grounded in real-world application and case studies. [8]
